guard.note: HurtByTargetGoal.canUse HEAD handler: a new LivingHurtByTargetGoalEvent.CanUse from the goal's fields (phase HEAD), posted on MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS, timestamp / alertSameType / toIgnoreAlert written back, DENY = false, ALLOW = true
the same before the toIgnoreDamage loop (phase BEFORE_IGNORE)
the event's only listener in the Goety family: DENY only in phase TAIL when the goal's mob is a Spider and the attacker wears the full Spider Darkmage set, otherwise nothing
the constructor stores the values, the getters return them (an untouched event writes back what it was built from)
the phase is stored and returned
canUse: RevelationFix's three injection points (HEAD, the toIgnoreDamage read, the canAttack call)

revelationfix_hurt_by_target_event_skip.conversion: MixinSquared @TargetHandler @Inject at HEAD (cancellable) of RevelationFix's HurtByTargetGoalMixin handlers canUse$head / canUse$beforeIgnore / canUse$tail merged into HurtByTargetGoal: return before the event is built when the live listener census of MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS (forge_listener_guard's ListenerCensus, allow-list ArmorEventsHandler.hurtByTargetCanUse) answers 0 or 1 and either the phase is not TAIL or the goal's mob is not a Spider; after an answer of 'another listener' the census is asked again every 256 calls (helper bons.furious.patch.revelationfix_coo49.RfEvents)
